title: GBC Store Catalog Sorting & AI Normalization Instructions
description: Authoritative machine-readable and LLM-executable specification for sorting, grouping, and normalizing digital game cards, gift cards, and subscriptions in the store catalog Excel file.
system_instruction_for_ai: You are an expert E-Commerce Product Catalog AI Specialist. When given the raw product catalog spreadsheet (or rows) alongside this JSON specification, your goal is to sort, group, and normalize each product entry according to these strict business laws. You must never create duplicate product cards for multi-country brands, and you must never combine different subscription plans/tiers into a single product card when there are no country variations.

law_1_multi_country_master_consolidation.name: The Multi-Country Master Product Law
law_1_multi_country_master_consolidation.rule: When a brand offers products across multiple countries or regional currencies (e.g. Bilibili ID/MY/TH/PH, Tinder US/UK/TR, PUBG Mobile Global/TR), ALL regional variations MUST be merged into a SINGLE Master Product row.
law_1_multi_country_master_consolidation.storefront_behavior: The storefront displays ONE product card with a Country dropdown selector. Selecting a country dynamically reveals that country's packages and prices.
law_1_multi_country_master_consolidation.forbidden: DO NOT create separate product cards like 'Bilibili (Philippines)' and 'Bilibili (Indonesia)'. All regional variants must share the exact same 'Product Name' = 'Bilibili'.

law_2_single_region_plan_separation.name: The Single-Region Distinct Plan Separation Law
law_2_single_region_plan_separation.rule: When a brand or service does NOT have country variations (e.g. Global/Single Region), multiple package types/tiers (e.g. New vs Renewal, Basic vs Pro vs Premier, Nitro vs Basic) MUST NOT be merged onto a single product page. Each distinct plan kind/tier MUST be an INDEPENDENT product card.
law_2_single_region_plan_separation.storefront_behavior: Each plan tier appears as its own clean product card on the storefront (e.g. 'Suno AI - Premier' and 'Suno AI - Renewal Premier').
law_2_single_region_plan_separation.allowed_variations_for_single_region: A single-region product may ONLY contain multiple variation rows if they represent duration periods (e.g. 1 Month, 3 Months, 1 Year), denomination tiers ($10, $25, $50), or tax variations (Standard vs With 27% VAT) of the EXACT SAME plan tier.

law_3_distinct_editions_and_platforms.name: The Distinct Edition & Platform Independence Law
law_3_distinct_editions_and_platforms.rule: Products that represent different hardware platforms (PC vs Console), distinct in-game currencies (Gold vs Diamonds), or separate tokens MUST NOT be consolidated into master products.

law_4_title_sanitization.name: The Product Title Sanitization Law
law_4_title_sanitization.rule: Strip vendor prefixes, category wrappers, internal duplicate tags, and raw country parentheticals from Product Names.

Product Name.description: Public product title displayed on the storefront. Must be clean without vendor wrappers.

Is Master Product.description: 'Yes' for multi-country regional products; 'No' for distinct plans, editions, or single-region cards.

Variation Name.description: Clean package or package-tier label (e.g. '7 Days Premium', '1 Month', '$25 USD', 'Standard', 'With 27% VAT').

Wholesale Cost (USD).description: Raw provider API cost in USD.

Retail Price (USD).description: Final customer price with store markup applied (e.g. cost * 1.07 rounded to 2 decimals).

Stock.description: Available stock quantity (typically 999999 for instant digital items).

External Item ID.description: Provider's unique product/item ID for API order execution.

service_subscription_plan_splitting_rule.description: Rules for splitting single-region / global AI & digital services into distinct product cards per plan kind/tier.

sorting_algorithm_step_by_step: STEP 1: Read the input row (Category, Brand, Item Name, Category Name, Price, Country).

STEP 2: Detect if the Brand belongs to 'multi_country_master_brands'. If YES -> Set 'Is Master Product' = 'Yes', set 'Product Name' = Clean Brand Name, parse the specific country from item name or category label into 'Country Name' and 'Country Code', and clean the package name into 'Variation Name'. All items for this brand share this single Product Name.

STEP 3: If the Brand is NOT a multi-country brand, check if it has country variations across its items. If more than 1 distinct valid country is detected across the brand -> Treat as Master Product ('Is Master Product' = 'Yes').
STEP 4: If the Brand has NO country variation (it is Global or single country):
4A: Check if the items represent distinct plan tiers, models, or types (e.g. 'Premier' vs 'Renewal Premier', 'Pro' vs 'Team', 'Nitro' vs 'Nitro Basic').

4B: If distinct plan kinds exist -> Split them into separate products! Set 'Product Name' = '{Brand} - {Plan Kind}', set 'Is Master Product' = 'No', set 'Country Name' = 'Global', 'Country Code' = 'GL'.
4C: The 'Variation Name' under each split product should only represent duration (e.g. '1 Month', '1 Year') or tax options ('Standard', 'With 27% VAT').
STEP 5: Sanitize all strings: strip 'Payment cards for services (', '#2', '#3', and redundant whitespace.

concrete_transformation_examples.result: Merged into 1 single Master Product card in store with an interactive Country Selector dropdown.
Split into 2 distinct product cards ('Suno AI - Premier' and 'Suno AI - Renewal Premier') preventing package clutter on single pages without country variations.
